description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Pentabreak Damage Boost (15s)] and [Crimson Steel Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Pentabreak Damage Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 5/10/15/20/30% if target has 1/2/3/4/5 of ATK, DEF, MAG, RES or MND reduced

description.name: Crimson Steel Mode
description.text: Grants Firelight Shadows +1/-1 after using Mottled Chroma if user has Firelight Shadows 0/1, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
